acceptanceCriteria: qualify-version takes the store mutation lock around read-modify-write.
A concurrency test shows two qualifications both retained.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1648 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1103, head 49b927b3d, TOL-V0-060..067); recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-v1-1648-witness-qualification.md Limits/Evidence. Expected: concurrent qualify-version runs serialize and both versions persist in taskman-obligation-qualifications.json. Actual: atomic rename without the store lock, so a concurrent writer can drop the other's entry (obligation_qualify.go).
title: obligations qualify-version writes the qualification allow-list without the store lock (last writer wins)
